speech.transcript: Security is not one tool. It is an approach plus a set of principles. Both matter and both come from the syllabus. Stalling gives three security approaches. Preventive stops an attack before it happens. Detective notices it while it happens. Corrective fixes it after it happens. Preventive mechanisms block the attack. Encryption. Firewalls. Access control. Stop it before it starts. Detective mechanisms, watch for trouble. Intrusion detection. Audit logs. Catch it while it is happening. Corrective mechanisms clean up after. Patches. Recovery procedures. Fix the damage and move on. CAHATE gives the principles. Defense in depth. Layered protection. No single mechanism suffices. Least privilege. Minimum permissions needed. Fail safe defaults. Deny by default. Three more. Economy of mechanism. Small, simple designs are easier to verify. Complete mediation. Check every access. Psychological acceptability. Security must not impede usability. Two final ones. Weakest link. Security level equals the security of the weakest component. Separation of duties. Split duties so collusion is required to subvert. Approaches stop, find and fix attacks. Principles guide the design. Everything else builds on these.
